crossRefs.note: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return…
requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

translations.web: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
translations.bsb: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
translations.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
translations.asv: For I do not wish to see you now by the way; for I hope to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
